periods.time: Three days after the Minotaur fight

name.zh: 贝尔凝视弥诺陶洛斯之角并整理心情

periods.summary: Bell rests alone after two days unconscious from the Minotaur battle, reflects that defeating the Minotaur matters to him even more than reaching Lv.2, and studies the broken Minotaur horn he kept as a drop item.
periods.cause: The fight exhausted Bell's body and mind, leaving him recovering and emotionally processing the battle's meaning.
periods.process: Bell recalls Hestia and Lili's relief, considers his Lv.2 status, lifts the cracked horn, notes its red-stained interior, and treats the silent horn as a farewell from the beast.
periods.outcome: Bell decides not to sink further into sentiment and prepares to attend his Lv.2 celebration.
periods.aftermath: He leaves the church and is soon chased by gods interested in his abnormal growth.
periods.significance: Clarifies that Bell's emotional milestone is not only leveling up but overcoming the Minotaur that haunted him.
